```{r}
source("mulitilevel_tapho_db.R")

system.time({
  tb <- build_multilevel_tapho_features(
    excel_path = "hspa.xlsx",
    position_max = c(5, 1, 1, 3, 4, 3, 3, 5, 4, 3, 5),
    levels = 1:5
  )
})

source("rfe_randomforest_taphonomy(1).R")
source("pca_funerary_surface_color.R")

res <- run_rfe(
  tb,
  task_name = "4class",
  unknown_sites = focus_sites,
  group_col = "site_id",
  use_smote = TRUE,
  over_ratio = 1
)

res$unknown_all_features$table
res$unknown_all_features$mean_acc
res$fold_assignment
```


```{r}
source("pca_funerary_surface_color.R")
focus_sites_ind <- c("Bilzingsleben", "Bolomor IV-VI", "Carihuela", "CdF Adult",
  "CdF Juvenil", "Ceprano", "Engis 2", "Feldhofer Grotte",
  "La Naulette", "Malladetes",

  "Saint-Césaire", "Scladina", "SH-89", "SH-90", "SH-95", "SH-98",
  "SH-98", "Steinheim", "WE A", "WE B", "WE C", "WE D",
  "WE E", "WE F", "WE G", "WE H")

pr3_ind <- pca_surface_plotly_ind(

  task_name = "4class",

  out_html = "pca_funerary_3d_ind_ALL_lvl.html"
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

tb %>%
  count(funerary_context, sort = TRUE)
```


```{r}
tb_fc <- tb %>%
  mutate(funerary_group = case_when(
    is.na(funerary_context) | funerary_context == "NA"        ~ "Unknown",
    str_detect(funerary_context, "Carnivore")                  ~ "Non-funerary (carnivore)",
    str_detect(funerary_context, ";")                          ~ "Mixed / multiple types",
    str_detect(funerary_context, "Collective")                 ~ "Collective burial",
    str_detect(funerary_context, "Inhumation multiple")        ~ "Inhumation multiple",
    str_detect(funerary_context, "Inhumation single")          ~ "Inhumation single",
    str_detect(funerary_context, "No inhumation")              ~ "No inhumation",
    str_detect(funerary_context, "Cremation|caching|Possible") ~ "Other funerary",
    TRUE                                                        ~ "Other"
  ))

tb_fc %>% count(funerary_group, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
out$df %>% count(funerary_context)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

set.seed(123)  # reproducible draw

is_coll <- str_detect(str_squish(tb$funerary_context), "Collective")
is_coll[is.na(is_coll)] <- FALSE   # NA funerary_context -> not collective

coll     <- tb[is_coll, ]
non_coll <- tb[!is_coll, ]

coll_keep <- coll %>% slice_sample(prop = 0.45)   # keep ~50%

tb_qfix <- bind_rows(non_coll, coll_keep)

tb_qfix %>%
  filter(str_detect(str_squish(funerary_context), "Collective")) %>%
  nrow()
# ~65-66 (half of 131)

```
